from pathlib import Path
pdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
pdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Move the non-background pattern down by one row."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != background:
                out[r + 1][c] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
p=pdir/'task-82a753a2.py'; p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.read_text())
